title: Scotch eggs
summary: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in seasoned sausage meat and crisp golden breadcrumbs.
method: Boil four eggs for 6–7 minutes, cool in iced water, then peel carefully.
Mix the sausage mince with the mustard and seasoning. Flatten into four discs and wrap each around an egg, sealing the seams.
Coat each in flour, then the beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs.
Heat the frying oil to 170°C and fry for 7–9 minutes until golden and the sausage meat reaches 75°C.
Drain on a rack, rest for 3 minutes, then halve to serve.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Boil four eggs for 6–7 minutes, cool in iced water and peel carefully.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Mix sausage mince with mustard and seasoning
flatten into four discs and wrap each around an egg, sealing seams.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Coat in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs
heat the frying oil to 170°C and fry for 7–9 minutes until golden and sausage meat reaches 75°C.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drain on a rack, rest 3 minutes and halve to serve.

tips: Keep sausage layer even so it cooks fully before breadcrumbs darken.
variations: Add chopped sage to sausage meat.
storage: Refrigerate cooked eggs up to 2 days; eat cold or reheat thoroughly.

title: Pad see ew
summary: Wide rice noodles wok-tossed with Chinese broccoli, egg and savoury dark soy until lightly charred.
method: Separate the noodles gently. Slice the chicken thinly and cut the Chinese broccoli stems and leaves separately.
Mix the light and dark soy sauces with the oyster sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok on high until smoking. Sear the chicken until cooked through, with no pink remaining.
Add the broccoli stems, then the leaves, and cook for 1 minute until the leaves are bright green and just wilted.
Push everything aside and scramble the eggs until just set. Add the noodles and sauce and toss on high for 2 minutes.
Let the noodles sit against the wok for 30 seconds until the edges char, then serve hot.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Separate noodles gently
slice chicken thinly and cut broccoli stems and leaves separately.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Mix soy sauces and oyster sauce
heat oil in wok until smoking and sear chicken until cooked through.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add broccoli stems, then leaves, and cook for 1 minute until the leaves are bright green
push aside, scramble eggs, add noodles and sauce and toss on high heat for 2 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Let noodles sit briefly against wok for charred edges, then serve hot.

tips: Cook in batches if wok is small to avoid steaming noodles.
variations: Swap chicken for firm tofu and vegetarian stir-fry sauce.
storage: Refrigerate 2 days; reheat thoroughly in a hot pan.

title: Künefe
summary: Crisp buttery shredded pastry enclosing stretchy cheese, soaked in fragrant lemon syrup.
method: Simmer the sugar, water and lemon juice in a saucepan over medium heat for 8 minutes, then cool the syrup completely.
Shred the kataifi, coat it evenly with the melted butter and press half into a 22 cm pan.
Spread the mozzarella over the pastry, leaving the edges clear, then cover with the remaining kataifi.
Cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes each side, until golden.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot künefe, rest for 2 minutes and scatter with the pistachios.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Simmer sugar, water and lemon for 8 minutes
cool syrup completely.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Shred kataifi, coat evenly with melted butter and press half into a 22 cm pan.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Spread shredded mozzarella over pastry leaving edges clear
cover with remaining kataifi and cook over medium-low heat 10 minutes each side until golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour cool syrup over hot kunefe, rest 2 minutes and scatter pistachios.

tips: Use low heat so pastry browns evenly while cheese melts.
variations: Add a little orange blossom water to syrup.
storage: Best eaten immediately while cheese is stretchy.

title: Stracciatella soup
summary: Delicate ribbons of egg and Parmesan swirling through hot chicken broth with spinach and lemon.
method: Bring the chicken stock to a gentle simmer in a large pot over medium heat.
Beat the eggs in a bowl with the grated Parmesan and nutmeg.
Add the baby spinach to the stock and wilt for 1 minute. Reduce the heat so the broth barely bubbles.
Pour in the egg mixture in a thin stream, stirring gently, and cook 1–2 minutes until set into soft ribbons.
Finish with grated lemon zest and black pepper, then serve immediately.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Bring stock to a gentle simmer
beat eggs with grated Parmesan and nutmeg.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Add spinach to stock and wilt for 1 minute
reduce heat so broth barely bubbles.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Pour egg mixture in a thin stream while stirring gently to form soft ribbons
cook 1–2 minutes until set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Finish with lemon zest and black pepper and serve immediately.

tips: Avoid a rolling boil, which breaks egg ribbons into tiny bits.
variations: Add a handful of cooked orzo for a heartier bowl.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat gently.

title: Salmorejo
summary: Thick chilled tomato and bread soup blended with olive oil, topped with egg and jamón.
method: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool and chop. Roughly cut the tomatoes and bread.
Blend the tomatoes, garlic and sherry vinegar until smooth. Add the bread and rest for 10 minutes to soften.
Blend again, streaming in the olive oil until thick and creamy. Chill for at least 1 hour.
Ladle into bowls and top with the chopped eggs, serrano ham and a drizzle of olive oil.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Boil eggs 9 minutes, cool and chop
roughly cut tomatoes and bread.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Blend tomatoes, garlic and vinegar until smooth
add bread and rest 10 minutes to soften.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Blend again while streaming in olive oil until thick and creamy
chill at least 1 hour.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Ladle into bowls and garnish with chopped eggs, serrano ham and olive oil.

tips: Use fully ripe tomatoes for naturally sweet flavour.
variations: Replace ham with chopped olives for vegetarian topping.
storage: Refrigerate soup up to 2 days; serve chilled.

title: Pajeon
summary: Crisp savoury spring-onion pancakes with tender centres and a tangy soy dipping sauce.
method: Cut the spring onions into pan-length pieces. Whisk the plain flour, rice flour, cold water and egg into a thin batter.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Lay the spring onions across the pan and pour the batter over evenly.
Cook for 4–5 minutes until the underside is crisp. Flip carefully and cook 3–4 minutes more.
Mix the soy sauce and rice vinegar for dipping. Cut the pancake into wedges and serve hot.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cut spring onions into pan-length pieces
whisk flours, water and egg into a thin batter.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Heat oil in a non-stick pan
lay spring onions across pan and pour batter over evenly.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook over medium heat 4–5 minutes until underside crisp, flip carefully and cook 3–4 minutes more.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Mix soy and vinegar for dipping
cut pancake into wedges and serve hot.

tips: Use cold batter and enough oil for crisp edges.
variations: Add cooked prawns to batter for seafood pajeon.
storage: Refrigerate 2 days; re-crisp in a skillet.

title: Torta caprese
summary: Rich flourless chocolate-almond cake with a delicate crackled top and fudgy centre.
method: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 22 cm cake tin. Gently melt the chocolate and butter together until smooth.
Whisk the egg yolks with half the sugar until pale. Fold in the melted chocolate mixture, ground almonds and vanilla.
Whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt and the remaining sugar to soft peaks. Gently fold into the chocolate mixture.
Pour into the tin and bake for 30–35 minutes, until the centre is just set.
Cool completely, then dust with icing sugar, if using, before slicing.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 22 cm cake tin
melt chocolate and butter gently.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Whisk egg yolks with half the sugar until pale
fold in chocolate, almonds and vanilla.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk whites with the salt and remaining sugar to soft peaks
fold gently into chocolate mixture and bake 30–35 minutes until centre is just set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cool completely and dust with icing sugar before slicing.

tips: A slight wobble in centre gives the classic fudgy texture.
variations: Add orange zest to chocolate batter.
storage: Airtight 3 days at room temperature or freeze 2 months.

title: Greek koulourakia
summary: Buttery twisted orange-scented biscuits with crisp edges and tender, lightly sweet centres.
method: Heat the oven to 180°C and line trays. Cream the butter and sugar until light.
Beat in one egg, the orange juice and zest, then fold in the flour and baking powder to make a soft dough.
Roll small pieces of dough into ropes and twist into braids. Brush with the remaining beaten egg.
Bake for 18–22 minutes until pale gold.
Cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and line trays
cream butter and sugar until light.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Beat in one egg, orange juice and zest
fold in flour and baking powder to make a soft dough.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Roll small pieces into ropes, twist into braids, brush with remaining beaten egg and bake 18–22 minutes until pale gold.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cool on trays 5 minutes then transfer to rack.

tips: Do not overwork dough or biscuits will become tough.
variations: Add vanilla or a pinch of mahlepi.
storage: Airtight up to 1 week or freeze 2 months.

title: Pain perdu
summary: Thick slices of day-old brioche soaked in vanilla custard and pan-fried until golden and soft inside.
method: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla in a shallow dish. Heat a large frying pan over medium heat.
Soak the brioche slices for 20–30 seconds per side, until the custard soaks in but the slices hold together.
Melt the butter in the pan, then cook the slices in batches for 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and the centre is set.
Serve straight away with the berries and a light dusting of icing sugar, if using.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla in a shallow dish
heat a skillet over medium.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Soak brioche 20–30 seconds per side so centre absorbs custard without falling apart.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Melt butter in pan over medium heat and cook slices in batches 3–4 minutes per side until golden and centre is set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Serve immediately with berries and a light dusting of icing sugar.

tips: Day-old brioche absorbs custard without collapsing.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly.

title: Hong shao rou
summary: Tender pork belly braised in soy, ginger and caramelised sugar until glossy and meltingly soft.
method: Cut the pork belly into 3 cm cubes, blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Melt the rock sugar with 1 tbsp water in a pan over medium heat until amber.
Carefully add the pork and coat in the caramel. Add the ginger, spring onions, soy sauce, dark soy and Shaoxing wine.
Add water to barely cover, then the star anise. Cover and simmer on low for 75–90 minutes, until the pork is tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy. Remove the aromatics and serve over steamed rice, if using.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cut pork belly into 3 cm cubes
blanch in boiling water 3 minutes and drain.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Melt sugar with 1 tbsp water until amber
add pork carefully and coat, then add ginger, spring onion, soy and wine.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add water to barely cover and star anise
simmer covered 75–90 minutes until tender, then uncover to reduce to glossy sauce.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove aromatics and serve over steamed rice.

tips: Keep braise gentle so fat renders without toughening meat.
variations: Add boiled eggs during final 20 minutes.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze 2 months.

title: Insalata di finocchi
summary: Shaved fennel and juicy orange segments tossed with olives and lemony olive oil.
method: Trim the fennel bulbs and shave them very thinly.
Segment the oranges over a bowl to catch the juice.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and reserved orange juice with salt and pepper.
Gently toss the fennel, orange segments and black olives with the dressing until coated.
Scatter the parsley and fennel fronds over just before serving.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Trim fennel and shave very thinly
segment oranges over a bowl to catch juice.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and reserved orange juice with salt and pepper.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Toss fennel, orange segments and olives gently with dressing.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Scatter parsley and fennel fronds over salad just before serving.

tips: Slice fennel as thinly as possible for a tender crunch.
storage: Best fresh; refrigerate up to 1 day.

title: Tortilla de espinacas
summary: Thick spinach-and-potato omelette with a tender centre and sweet slow-cooked onions.
method: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes, slice the onion and wash the spinach.
Cook the potatoes and onion in the olive oil in a pan over low heat for 15–20 minutes until tender, not browned. Wilt the spinach separately.
Beat the eggs with the salt, then fold in the drained potatoes, onion and spinach.
Pour into a non-stick pan over low heat and cook 6–8 minutes until set underneath. Flip carefully and cook 3 minutes more.
Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Peel and slice potatoes thinly
slice onion and wash spinach.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Cook potatoes and onion gently in olive oil over low heat for 15–20 minutes until tender without browning
wilt spinach separately.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Beat eggs with the salt, fold in drained potatoes, onion and spinach
pour into non-stick pan and cook on low 6–8 minutes until set underneath, then flip carefully and cook 3 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest 5 minutes before cutting wedges.

tips: Use low heat to keep omelette centre tender.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly or serve cool.

title: Moroccan briouats
summary: Crisp triangular filo parcels filled with warmly spiced minced lamb and toasted almonds.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Finely dice the onion, then toast and chop the almonds until golden.
Cook the lamb and onion in a pan over medium-high heat until well browned and cooked through.
Stir in the cumin, cinnamon, almonds and parsley, then let the filling cool.
Cut the filo into strips and brush with melted butter. Add filling and fold into triangles.
Bake for 18–22 minutes until crisp and golden.
Rest for 3 minutes and serve with lemon wedges, if you like.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 200°C
finely dice onion and toast then chop almonds until golden.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Cook lamb and onion in a pan over medium-high heat until browned
stir in cumin, cinnamon, almonds and parsley, then cool filling.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cut filo into strips, brush with melted butter, add filling and fold into triangles
bake 18–22 minutes until crisp and golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest 3 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

tips: Keep filo under a damp towel to prevent drying.
variations: Use feta and spinach instead of lamb.
storage: Refrigerate cooked parcels up to 2 days; re-crisp in oven.

title: Riz bi haleeb
summary: Silky milk rice pudding perfumed with rosewater and orange blossom, topped with pistachios.
method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in a pot with 250 ml water over medium-low heat until the grains soften, about 12 minutes.
Add the milk and sugar and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring so it doesn't stick.
Mix the cornflour with a little cold milk, stir it in and cook 3 minutes until thick.
Take off the heat and stir in the rosewater and orange blossom water.
Portion into bowls and chill. Scatter with chopped pistachios to serve.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse rice briefly
simmer with 250 ml water over medium-low heat until grains soften.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Add milk and sugar and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Mix cornflour with a little cold milk, stir into pudding and cook 3 minutes until thick
remove from heat and add rosewater and orange blossom water.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Portion into bowls, chill and scatter chopped pistachios.

tips: Use floral waters sparingly; their flavour can overpower rice.

title: Sopes
summary: Thick corn masa rounds with crisp pinched edges, topped with beans, salsa and fresh cheese.
method: Mix the masa harina, warm water and salt into a soft dough. Rest it covered for 10 minutes, then shape eight thick discs.
Cook the discs in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes each side. While still warm, pinch the edges into raised rims.
Return the sopes to the pan over medium heat with the oil. Cook 2 minutes each side until crisp.
Warm the refried beans separately until hot.
Fill each sope with beans, salsa, crumbled queso fresco and sliced avocado.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Mix masa, water and salt into soft dough
rest covered 10 minutes, then shape eight thick discs.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Cook discs in a dry skillet over medium heat 2 minutes each side
while warm, pinch edges into raised rims.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Return to pan with a little oil and cook 2 minutes each side until crisp
warm refried beans separately.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fill each sope with beans, salsa, crumbled cheese and avocado.

tips: Pinch rims while discs are still warm and flexible.
variations: Top with shredded chicken or mushrooms.
storage: Store plain cooked bases 2 days refrigerated; assemble fresh.

title: Minestra maritata
summary: Comforting broth with tiny meatballs, tender greens and pasta finished with grated Parmesan.
method: Mix the pork mince with the egg, breadcrumbs and half the Parmesan. Roll into 2 cm meatballs.
Bring the chicken stock to a simmer in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced carrot and celery and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the meatballs and simmer for 8–10 minutes, until cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Add the small pasta and cook to packet time, adding the kale for the final 3 minutes, until tender.
Ladle into bowls and top with the remaining Parmesan and pepper.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Mix mince with egg, breadcrumbs and half Parmesan
roll into small 2 cm meatballs.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Bring stock to a simmer with diced carrot and celery for 8 minutes.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add meatballs and simmer 8–10 minutes until cooked through
add pasta and cook according to packet, then kale for final 3 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Ladle into bowls and finish with remaining Parmesan and pepper.

tips: Make small even meatballs so they cook quickly without drying.
variations: Use turkey mince instead of pork.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; add stock when reheating.

title: Lemon bars
summary: Buttery shortbread topped with a bright, tangy lemon custard and a dusting of icing sugar.
method: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20 cm square tin. Rub the butter into the plain flour and icing sugar until it comes together.
Press the mixture into the tin and bake for 18–20 minutes, until lightly golden.
Whisk the eggs, caster sugar, lemon juice and the 2 tbsp flour until smooth.
Pour the filling over the hot base and bake for 20–25 minutes, until set.
Cool completely, then chill for 2 hours before dusting with icing sugar and slicing.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 175°C and line a 20 cm square tin
rub butter into flour and icing sugar.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Press shortbread mixture into tin and bake 18–20 minutes until lightly golden.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk eggs, caster sugar, lemon juice and 2 tbsp flour until smooth
pour over hot base and bake 20–25 minutes until set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cool completely and chill 2 hours before dusting and slicing.

tips: Chill thoroughly for neat clean slices.
variations: Add lime zest for a citrus twist.
